info.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for MMR vaccination.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a non-medical (personal-belief) vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a non-medical exemption (religious, philosophical, or personal-belief) from vaccination requirements.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a non-medical exemption from one or more required vaccines. The exemption categories permitted differ by state law - some allow religious exemptions only, others also allow philosophical or personal-belief exemptions - and this harmonized field aggregates whichever non-medical categories the state reports. A value of 0 is a reported zero (no exemptions of this kind that year), not a placeholder for missing data. The source stopped breaking exemptions out by category starting with the 2023-24 school year, so this field is NA for 2023-24 and 2024-25; see rate_mmr_religious_exempt for the MMR-specific series, which the source still publishes for those years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a non-medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical vaccination exemption
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from one or more required vaccines.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students with a physician-certified medical exemption from one or more required vaccines, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey. The source stopped breaking exemptions out by category starting with the 2023-24 school year, so this field is NA for 2023-24 and 2024-25; see rate_mmr_medical_exempt for the MMR-specific series, which the source still publishes for those years.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a medical vaccination exemption.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a medical exemption from MMR vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a medical exemption from the MMR vaccination requirement.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a medical exemption from the MMR series specifically, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey. A value of 0 is a reported zero (no MMR medical exemptions that year), not a placeholder for missing data. The source began collecting MMR-specific exemption data at the start of the 2016-17 school year, so this field is NA for 2009-10 through 2015-16.

info.long_name: Proportion of students with a religious exemption from MMR vaccination
info.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students with a religious exemption from the MMR vaccination requirement.
info.long_description: Share of assessed school students holding a religious exemption from the MMR series specifically, as reported in the state's annual school immunization survey. A value of 0 is a reported zero (no MMR religious exemptions that year), not a placeholder for missing data. info.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students had a religious exemption from MMR vaccination.
